notes: I checked all 27 claims at W = bd471af7. 12 conform and 15 do not, and every mismatch is drift: a log entry, an annotation or the spec records the move. The drifts are mostly renames: merge→combine (D-204), UninitializedSlots→UninitializedInputs and get_slot→get_input (D-206), init_x→x_init and output_types→y_types (D-267), capture→checkpoint (D-273/D-274), BuildError→DiagnosticError (D-222), seven→nine TrimProblem fields (D-262) and NamedTuple→plain arrays (D-475). Several entries say the log keeps its day's vocabulary (D-204, D-206, D-405), so the user may prefer annotations to rewrites for the rename-only drifts. Two drifts are about behaviour, not names. L14-078: linearize's default form takes its frozen cells from the restored checkpoint, with no establishment round (D-274). L14-087: checks are also evaluated once at the setup guess to observe their shape (src/trim.jl:604), which the spec states and the log does not. I edited no tracked file and committed nothing. My one artifact is the probe script /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/L14_v/probe.jl, run twice.
